# Field guide photograph credits

Verified against Wikimedia Commons file metadata on 25 September 2026.

These are real photographs. The mangrove and crocodile photographs were taken in Bhitarkanika; the bird photographs are identification references from the locations noted below. No photographer endorses this project.

All files are Wikimedia-generated reduced-size JPEG previews (960 pixels wide), downloaded unchanged. No cropping, retouching or recoloring has been applied. The CC BY-SA images, including these reduced-size versions, remain available under their respective licenses. The CC0 image remains public domain under that dedication.
